Media opens and external track loads use reviewed filesystem/network permissions and manifest-domain checks. setUIVisibility now blocks future control reveals when enabled, matching IINA's disable-UI state. History getter, the window proxy, exact window semantics, GUI command execution and native platform validation remain open

QuickJS console log/info/warn/error accept a single string; variadic values; object formatting and severity parity remain open

Trash, Foundation encodings missing from or mapped differently by the WHATWG decoder, exact IINA path semantics, and native file-manager reveal verification remain open
GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE use permission-gated promises with manifest-domain checks; downloads, XML-RPC and HTTP transport runtime verification remain open
